meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: Claude会比较当前代码与最新发布的npm版本，找出所有未发布的改动，按发布层分类，生成影响矩阵，并给出每层及整体的版本升级建议。
howto.when: 当用户提到“unpublished changes”、“changelog”等关键词，或询问“改了什么”时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude compares local code with published npm versions, lists unpublished changes by release layer, and recommends per-layer and overall version bumps.
howto.when_en: Triggers on mentions of unpublished changes, changelog, or what-changed queries.
